name: check
description: Can this be trusted? attack: a fresh agent that has not seen your reasoning finds what is wrong with a plan, a brief or finished work and returns findings; a second fresh agent checks any finding that would change a decision; the attack is kept as a file. claims: fresh agents verify what a report, draft or hand-back asserts before it travels: that "done" is true of the artifact, that each cited source says what it is cited for, that a synthesis covers its sources.
